description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the jjwg_Maps module in a SuiteCRM project, testing various functionalities such as address formatting, geocode info updates, validation methods, and integration with other modules.

classes.name: jjwg_MapsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the functionality of the jjwg_Maps module in SuiteCRM, covering constructor properties, configuration methods, geocode updating, address formatting, validation routines, and related module interactions.

methods.name: testjjwg_Maps
methods.description: Tests the constructor and basic property initialization of the jjwg_Maps bean.

methods.name: testconfiguration
methods.description: Tests the configuration method of the jjwg_Maps bean, ensuring it executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testsaveConfiguration
methods.description: Tests saving configuration with default and custom data, marked as incomplete due to environment dependency.

methods.name: testupdateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Validates the updateGeocodeInfo method with beans missing and with set latitude and longitude attributes.

methods.name: testupdateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Tests updating related meetings geocode info with different beans representing Accounts.

methods.name: testupdateMeetingGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Validates updating geocode info for a Meeting bean.

methods.name: testupdateGeocodeInfoByAssocQuery
methods.description: Tests updateGeocodeInfoByAssocQuery with invalid and valid parameters.

methods.name: testupdateGeocodeInfoByBeanQuery
methods.description: Tests updating geocode info using a bean query with and without set attributes.

methods.name: testdeleteAllGeocodeInfoByBeanQuery
methods.description: Tests deletion of geocode info by bean query for different bean types, with expected false and null results.

methods.name: testgetGeocodeAddressesResult
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of geocode address results with invalid and valid table names.

methods.name: testdefineMapsAddress
methods.description: Tests defineMapsAddress method for various object types (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case, Project, Meeting).

methods.name: testdefineMapsFormattedAddress
methods.description: Validates the formatting of address data for different address types.

methods.name: testis_valid_lng
methods.description: Checks longitude validation with invalid and boundary values.

methods.name: testis_valid_lat
methods.description: Checks latitude validation with invalid and boundary values.

methods.name: testlogGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Ensures logGeocodeInfo executes without exceptions for a bean with geocode data.

methods.name: testgetProspectLists
methods.description: Simple test to verify getProspectLists returns an array.
